title: Site contract
what: The site-tool trait, the roads a tool is given, and the wrapper serving a site tool as a placed web entry with its listing, catalogue item and claimed hosts. Lives in src/site/; the placed contract test is under tests/site-placed/.

title: Web helper client
what: What a tool asks the record's web helper on its socket, one JSON line each way: the core tools' requests, a site tool's roads and the research guard round its call. Lives in src/site/helper.rs.

title: Shared site readings
what: The readings several site tools share: markup, scripts, numbers, journals, markets, ordered JSON, placed text and the forum engines. Lives in src/site/readers/.

title: Unread page record
what: A page both the direct read and the real Chrome failed, written to the store with its site and shape by a research run's web helper. Lives in src/site/unread.rs.
